interpretation_rules: All ratios are candidate8628 over baseline890 within each pair. Prior a1bf or9aca results are not pooled, multiplied or inherited.
Time phases are measured wall intervals at100ns observed granularity on this host; a phase can include preemption and cannot establish CPU cost or causal attribution.
The worker-create-ready interval contains thread creation and ready-handshake before go; it is separately observed, not a proof that the algorithm caused the difference.

Hot and full-round wall measure different scopes. Raw round-wall includes domain preparation and close; parse/report, initial result buffers and after-timestamp destructors remain documented exclusions.

Additive decomposition uses means within each raw process and matching same-profile pair. Medians of component deltas do not sum to a median total; no lifetime-changing stream-minus-held subtraction is performed.
All undefined zero-baseline ratios remain null and all numeric deltas are retained. Descriptive ratios do not establish product or target-device qualification.
